# Catalog of AliExpress products to import as DRAFT Shopify products.
#
# Run:  node scripts/importCatalog.mjs --dry-run     (checks everything, writes nothing)
#       node scripts/importCatalog.mjs               (imports for real)
#       node scripts/importCatalog.mjs --only Mooer  (one brand)

# Format: a [Brand] header, then one AliExpress product URL or numeric id per
# line. Every product under a header is checked against that brand: if the
# listing's "Brand Name" doesn't match, it is skipped (not imported) so a
# lookalike or knockoff listing can't slip in. Use the brand's OFFICIAL
# AliExpress store page to collect the links.
#
# Lines starting with # are comments; so is anything after "  #" on a line.
